verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents local-first operation, self-hosting via Docker, and a developer API for 'programmatic reading' of an instance. None of it documents a user-facing feature to export all data (chats, workspaces, documents) in open formats. Local storage and the API are adjacent building blocks, not the export capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
